method: Connected Google Drive list filtered to direct, non-trashed folders and ordered by name; no folder contents were read, modified, moved, shared, uploaded, or deleted.

classification.completionGate: Each candidate must independently satisfy evidence, rendered-media, final QA, source-metadata, and exact private-Drive-package verification before it can affect completion counts.
classification.preservationRule: Retain all folders and files. Do not overwrite, move, delete, publish, or treat names/duplicates as proof of completion.
